liked_in_others: Person chose C (Pay Streak) with the core icon. No comment on the others.
icon_idea: The core sample: a snow-capped peak on a cut column of strata with the gold seam running through it.
name: Pay Streak
idea: A core sample of the claim: the mountain, the mine and the train on top, and beneath them the shafts, the lamplit galleries and the gold seam it is all for.
composition: Symmetrical and centred on coach green inside a gold lining: gold-leaf lettering crowns a tall cut column of rock that runs down the middle of the screen, with two side-by-side buttons at its foot; on desktop the two words of the name split either side of the peak.
flavor: Pullman green and gold leaf: signwriter's shaded fat-face letters, vermilion lining and a bright noon world like a showroom model.
